rationale: The gap-up was immediately rejected — the first minute dumped from 43.53 to 42.01 on ~67% of session volume, and the recovery since is on steadily declining volume (252k→75k→49k), which fits distribution/chop rather than a trend in either direction. The 57.7 bps spread exceeds the 5-minute ATR ($0.16), so round-trip costs consume more than a typical bar's movement, making any short-horizon expectancy negative before the thesis is even tested. With no confirmed break of today's high (43.61) or low (42.01), a negative sentiment print with no headline, and a risk-off tape (SPY -0.71%, VIXY +3.53%), neither the long continuation nor the gap-fade short has mechanical confirmation — the disciplined action is to stand aside until price proves a direction on expanding volume.
